title: Banana and Pineapple Layers (Cameroonian Dessert)
author: Darlene (International Cuisine)
desc: Coconut cream boiled and cooled, then bananas, tomatoes, pineapple and avocado layered in bowls, topped with the thickened cream and chopped peanuts and chilled.
longDesc: A dessert from the International Cuisine site, labelled Cuisine: Cameroon and described as a cool, light ending to a Cameroonian meal. The coconut cream is brought to the boil in a pan and set aside to cool. Meanwhile bananas, tomatoes, pineapple and avocado are piled in alternating layers in individual bowls; the thickened coconut cream goes on top with the chopped peanuts; chill and serve cold. The author calls it ‘an interesting combination of flavors’ — tomato and avocado in a dessert is unusual and recorded as such. The page’s total time of 10 minutes does not allow for cooling and chilling.
ingredients: 2 firm ripe bananas, peeled and sliced
steps: Bring the coconut cream to the boil in a pan. Set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, pile the bananas, tomatoes, pineapple and avocado in alternating layers in individual bowls.
Top with the thickened coconut cream and sprinkle with the chopped peanuts.
Chill in the fridge and serve cold.
chefTips: The printed cue is ‘thickened coconut cream’.
Boil, cooling and chilling times are not printed.
The author found the flavour combination interesting.
healthBenefits: Fruit-heavy with coconut cream and peanuts.
culturalNote: The page labels the cuisine Cameroon and names no region or group. Byline: Darlene at International Cuisine (a first name plus the site name).
sources: Title as printed: ‘Cameroon Banana and Pineapple Layers’.
